implementation.note: reference TVAE (VGM mode-specific normalisation + one-hot, tanh-Gaussian numeric decoder); replaces the old self-implemented 'tabvae' baseline
implementation.checkpoint_selection: per-epoch val evaluation via the tqdm epoch hook (library loop runs verbatim); best decoder state restored, same as train_ctgan_v2
implementation.sdv_note: sdv.single_table.TVAESynthesizer wraps this same ctgan.TVAE; we call the raw synthesiser for parity with train_ctgan_v2.

selection.rule: min 0.5*(val SRMSE-1 + SRMSE-2) - w*mean block F1, on the held-out val split
